reviews.name: Ryan Cooper
reviews.title: Strongest 12V car vacuum I have tested — handles sand and gravel
reviews.body: I tested 6 different car vacuums and this one has the highest suction at 5000Pa. It pulls sand from the carpet, crumbs from the seat crevices, and even pet hair. The washable HEPA filter is a huge plus. See the before/after photos of my truck bed.

reviews.name: Nina Johansson
reviews.title: Compact enough to keep in the glove box, powerful enough for weekly cleans
reviews.body: At just 1.2kg it fits in our glove box. The 5m car charger cable reaches every corner of our SUV. The LED light on the nozzle is perfect for cleaning under seats at night. No complaints after 8 months of weekly use.

reviews.name: Ahmed Hassan
reviews.title: DC 12V works perfectly in our extreme summer heat
reviews.body: Many car accessories fail in Dubai summers. This vacuum has survived temperatures above 45°C in the car. The cord management is neat and the dust cup is easy to empty. The transparent design lets you see when it needs cleaning.
